target.statement: MSMixer achieves MSE 0.406 on ETTm1 at horizon 96 (Table 2, row ETTm1 H=96, column MSMixer MSE)

compute.basis: Paper reports CPU training times of ~115s per configuration; reproducing one cell requires implementing the model from scratch (no code released), downloading ETTm1, and training for up to 15 epochs with early stopping, plus baseline comparisons if needed.

blockers: No code released (only 'available upon reasonable request')
ETTm training data capped at 17,420 steps, which may affect reproducibility
Single seed results, no variance reported
title: MSMixer: Learned Multi-Scale Temporal Mixing with Complementary Linear Shortcut for Long-Term Time Series Forecasting
